fact: The Data Protection Commission, led by Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, is acting under Act 843, which the document gives as the body running registration and spot checks (document published 2026-10-04).

The Commission is acting under Act 843 with Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, and received two pickup vehicles bought from its internally generated funds on 2026-08-20; it operates only from its head office.
The Data Protection Commission, with Executive Director Arnold Kavaarpuo, is named as the registering body and spoke at the Data Protection Conference in Accra.
The Data Protection Commission, led by Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, is acting, with government pledging policy backing and institutional cooperation.
The Data Protection Commission, led by Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, is acting and said it will intensify compliance checks and regulatory actions.

TechAfrica News reports the Minister for Communication swore in the new Governing Board of the Data Protection Commission, chaired by Teki Akuetteh, with the Acting Executive Director and seven other named members sworn in and three more to follow; the swearing-in was on 'Wednesday' before the article date, so the article's published date of 2025-08-01 is used.

The judgment says the Data Protection Commission is established under Act 843 and orders it to see a forensic audit of Bolt's database and liveness checks by other ride-hailing platforms; it gives no appointment of members and no sign that the Commission has acted.

The Communications Minister said on 7 September 2026 that the Data Protection Commission's regulatory activity rose 51.5 per cent and newly registered data controllers 98.4 per cent in the first half of 2026, showing the existing body is doing the job.

The Commission's own page, on a 20 February 2026 vehicle commissioning, calls it an independent statutory body established under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), with a named Executive Director and a Board Member attending.

The 2026 programme-based budget estimates of the Ministry of Finance appropriate GHS 9,720,400 to the Data Protection Commission, a statutory body under Act 843, funded wholly from internally generated funds with 39 staff; the document's published date 2026-01-01 is used.
A law firm article of 7 August 2025 says the Data Protection Commission holds supervisory authority under Act 843 but has been absent from public discussion of an inter-agency data dispute.

Ghana's Data Protection Commission, led by Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, said it registered 2,575 data controllers in 2026 and is adding spot checks, inspections and complaint investigations under Act 843.

Graphic Online reports the Data Protection Commission, led by Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, ran a field enforcement exercise in Accra on 12 October 2026 under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843).

Ghana's Data Protection Commission ran an enforcement operation on 2026-10-12 and directed Nyaho Medical Centre to report to the Police CID over its expired data protection registration certificate, under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), per MyJoyOnline.
Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo spoke for the Data Protection Commission, which he said had intensified compliance monitoring and enforcement and designated 2026 its year of enforcement.
The article says the Ghana Data Protection Commission, under the Ministry of Communications and Digitalisation, recently held a validation workshop for the Ghana Data Strategy.
The article says Ghana's Data Protection Commission was created under the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) and exists to oversee personal data; it states no appointment or ruling.

Ghana's Data Protection Commission issued a statement reported on 2026-10-20 warning the Minority Caucus, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and media houses over disclosure of the personal data of 1,964 evacuees, and announced a regulatory review under Act 843.
Ghana News Agency quotes Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo as Executive Director and Commissioner of Ghana's Data Protection Commission, which was acting on emerging AI and deepfake challenges.

Ghana's Data Protection Commission issued a statement on 20 October 2026 saying the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Parliament are registered data controllers in good standing with it, and that it will review the disclosure of evacuees' data.
The Data Protection Commission, led by Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, launched Data Protection Month 2026 in Accra on 26 January 2026 and declared 2026 a year of enforcement.
MyJoyOnline reports that Ghana's Data Protection Commission carried out inspections on 12 October 2026, including a clinic and two hospitals, and recorded 2,575 data controller registrations in 2026.
Samani writes that Ghana's Data Protection Commission only began enforcement spot checks in October 2026, so the body is acting.

Ghana's Data Protection Commission, through its Director of Regulatory and Compliance Quintin Akrobotu, ran compliance checks and a week-long enforcement exercise under Section 81 of the Data Protection Act.

The Data Protection Commission directed named companies including Menkish Impex Ltd, Polytex Ghana Limited and JA Biney Packaging to report to the CID and the Commission and regularise their registration, for operating unregistered or with expired certificates.
The Data Protection Commission, headed by Executive Director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, spoke at the 2025 Civil Service Week lecture in Accra.

Citi Newsroom reports that President John Dramani Mahama appointed Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo as Acting Executive Director of Ghana's Data Protection Commission; no appointment date is given beyond the article's.
